title: Dodo: insufficient flow control (security-scan gate bypass)
description: A Jenkins controller scans and deploys Wonderland's dodo repository (Terraform for an S3 bucket, hosted on Gitea). A security scanner (Checkov) runs as a deploy gate and refuses a publicly-readable bucket. The scanner reads its configuration from the repository, so an attacker with write access makes the bucket public and adds a .checkov.yaml that neuters the scan (soft-fail plus a non-existent check); the gate then passes, the gated deploy runs the malicious change, and a Global-scope release-token credential is exfiltrated to the build console in a form the masker will not catch (OWASP CICD-SEC-1, Insufficient Flow Control Mechanisms). Reproduces the "Dodo" challenge from CI/CD Goat.
question: Bypass the Checkov deploy gate on the Wonderland/dodo pipeline and exfiltrate the Global-scope release-token credential from the build console.
